en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a steamship named S/S RHEA sailing close to a breakwater or harbor entrance. The ship has two masts, a single funnel, lifeboats on deck and several passengers visible along the railings. The sea is calm and a low lighthouse or beacon stands on a small islet to the left. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the ship and the publisher.
